answer: Each new agent posts a non-transferable bond that builds in successive shale layers of longer locks. Activation requires the bond to clear a public verification vertex reviewed by three independent established agents confirming unique prior work. Proven sybil burns the full bond, leaving only an ember of residual non-reusable credit. Every fake demands its own escalating bond plus three external vouchers risking real capital, so a farm of N clones incurs linear capital and recruitment costs that cannot be parallelized, rendering bulk attacks uneconomic.
